summary: - **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#162](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/162)** — The Delphes-to-EDM4hep converter now assigns the pion mass to every track that is not an electron or muon, so energy, mass and momentum are consistent. It also sets PDG IDs on tracks and leptons, so analysts no longer need to infer particle identity from the mass. Converted outputs change slightly, and a new test catches lepton charge errors.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#101](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/101)** — Fixes several problems in the GENFIT TrackFitter: wrong units in the helix-to-Cartesian Jacobian and in the z0 conversion; a singular initial z0 covariance; broken hit–track associations introduced during filtering. Fitted track states are now propagated with GENFIT's native extrapolation, with AtFirstHit/AtLastHit defined at the first and last digitised hits. The AtIP state is documented as not meaningful for displaced tracks.

- **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#489](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/489)** — Removes the deprecated `inputReader` Python module. It depended on `PodioInput`, which no longer exists in k4FWCore. Users must migrate to `k4MarlinWrapper.io_helpers`.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#433](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/433)** — Fixes boolean properties on the `k4run` command line, which previously could not be switched off (`False` was interpreted as `True`). Booleans now accept True/False, true/false or 1/0 and reject anything else. A bare flag now means `True`.

- **[key4hep/DDML#19](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/19)** — Adds a `ddml` Python module providing `ddml_physics` and `add_shower_model`, plus pre-built configurations for the included models. It replaces the sprawling flag-driven `ddsim_steer.py` logic and streamlines ML fast-shower setup in ddsim steering files.

- **[key4hep/DDML#16](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/16)** — ML models are now initialised before the event loop instead of lazily, and geometry is initialised late enough for DD4hep settings to apply. The default now switches to non-hadron showers, which changes behaviour for existing configurations.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#383](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/383)** — Adds a digitisation/reconstruction configuration and CTest for IDEA option 2, based on the reduced geometry. It is synchronised with the IDEA_o1 tracking and track-validation setup.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#400](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/400)** — Adds an EvtGen decay card for Λb → Λ(1520) νν̄ with Λ(1520) → pK⁻, including the charge-conjugate chain, for FCC-ee flavour-physics samples.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#70](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/70)** — Adds `TrackerHit3D` conversion to the Gaudi KalTest machinery so it behaves like the Marlin version, fixing k4GaudiPandora#58. FTD composite spacepoints (used in ILD reconstruction) are still not handled.

- **[HEP-FCC/root2gltf#16](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/16)** — Moves the conversion depth from a config property to a command-line argument, enabling full-depth conversion. Remaining config properties are renamed, so existing config files must be updated to the new format.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses#561](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/561)** — Updates HTCondor log/output handling for pre-EDM4hep-1 stacks. HTCondor warnings about log-file placement are no longer treated as failures, which previously triggered up to 10 retried submissions.

- **[HEP-FCC/fcc-drs#106](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-drs/pull/106)** — Dataset requests gain a Detector(s) field, which accepts multiple comma-separated detectors (e.g. IDEA, ALLEGRO). The field is required whenever the Final Processing Stage is anything other than generation, enforced in the form and on the server. It appears in notification emails.
